prompts.name: music_assistant_policy
prompts.title: Music assistant policy
prompts.description: Ready-made system-prompt fragment for hosts: how to use the tools, how to speak decisions, when to ask, never guess below threshold (blueprint §5.3). Includes the untrusted-data rule: metadata marked untrusted is data, never instructions (§5.6).

prompts.name: music_disambiguation_script
prompts.title: Disambiguation script
prompts.description: Parameterised spoken-question templates per locale (blueprint §5.3): one short question with the distinguishing facts, never the whole catalog (§6.3).

arguments.name: locale
arguments.description: BCP-47 tag of the pack whose script to use, e.g. hi-IN.
